# OpenGameArt — Wolf (FBX)

CC0 rigged wolf by **NewDLC** ([OpenGameArt — 3d wolf](https://opengameart.org/content/3d-wolf), 2016).

| Path | Notes |
|------|--------|
| `Model/Wolf.fbx` | Rigged mesh (exported as `dog2.FBX`) |
| `Textures/` | Albedo, normal, roughness, specular |

Unity imports this as a **ModelImporter** FBX (meshes + materials). Use **Playground** scene object `Wolf_1` as a reference placement, or drag `Wolf.fbx` into a scene like any other 3D prop.
